cases.d: Verify GET /api/users returns every account sorted by name, without secrets.
exp: Response JSON body is a list of accounts sorted by full name.
Each item has id, fullName, email, roleId, roleName and isActive; for thuky@trustcabinet.local roleName is "Thư ký".
The body contains no passwordHash, googleSubjectId or old role field.
pre: Seeded accounts exist (quantri, thuky, chutoa, thanhvien @trustcabinet.local).
Signed in as quantri@trustcabinet.local, whose role has AdminUsers.

cases.d: Verify GET /api/users returns 401 when not authenticated.
Verify GET and POST /api/users return 403 for a user without AdminUsers.
steps: Send GET request to /api/users with header Authorization: Bearer <access token of thuky@trustcabinet.local>.
Send POST request to /api/users with the same header and an empty body.
exp: No account is listed or created.
pre: Signed in as thuky@trustcabinet.local (Secretary, MeetingCreator only, no AdminUsers).

cases.d: Verify an administrator whose role lost AdminUsers is refused at once, without signing in again.

req.as: Authorization: Bearer <access token of the administrator, issued before the change>

exp: The old access token no longer grants AdminUsers.
pre: The administrator signed in and kept the access token.
Afterwards the administrator's role was changed to Member (no capability).

cases.d: Verify GET /api/users/{id} returns one account, and 404 for an unknown id.
steps: Send GET request to /api/users/<id of thanhvien@trustcabinet.local> with header Authorization: Bearer <access token of quantri@trustcabinet.local>.
Send GET request to /api/users/<random UUID that no account has> with the same header.
exp: The first request returns HTTP 200 OK with email "thanhvien@trustcabinet.local".
The second request returns HTTP 404 Not Found.

cases.d: Verify POST /api/users creates an active account and returns MSG07 with 201 and a Location header.

req.body: { "fullName": "Trần Chủ Toạ", "email": "chutoa2@trustcabinet.local", "password": "MatKhauHopLe@2026", "roleId": "<id of the Chair role>" }

exp: Response JSON body: code "MSG07", message "Tạo tài khoản thành công.".
user.email is "chutoa2@trustcabinet.local" and user.isActive is true.
Location header is /api/users/<id of the new account>.

cases.d: Verify creating an account records the signed-in administrator as the actor in the audit log.

req.body: { "fullName": "Trần Chủ Toạ", "email": "chutoa3@trustcabinet.local", "password": "MatKhauHopLe@2026", "roleId": "<id of the Chair role>" }

steps: Open the audit_log table and find the newest row.
exp: Exactly one new audit entry is written.

cases.d: Verify POST /api/users returns MSG08 with 409 for an email that is already used.
exp: Response JSON body: code "MSG08", message "Email đã được sử dụng.".

cases.d: Verify POST /api/users returns 400 naming every invalid field.
exp: Response JSON body errors has exactly the fields email, fullName and password.

cases.d: Verify POST /api/users returns MSG09 on roleId for a role that does not exist.
steps: Send POST request to /api/users with header Authorization: Bearer <access token of quantri@trustcabinet.local> and body { "fullName": "Tên hợp lệ", "email": "hople@trustcabinet.local", "password": "MatKhauHopLe@2026", "roleId": "01990000-0000-7000-8000-000000000000" }.
Repeat with "roleId": "Chair" (a name, not an id).
Repeat with "roleId": null.
exp: Each request returns HTTP 400 Bad Request.
Each response JSON body has code "MSG09" and errors.roleId "Vai trò không tồn tại.".

cases.d: Verify the created account is returned with its role id and role name.

req.body: { "fullName": "Trần Chủ Toạ", "email": "chutoa4@trustcabinet.local", "password": "MatKhauHopLe@2026", "roleId": "<id of the Chair role>" }

exp: user.roleId is the id of the Chair role.

cases.d: Verify PUT /api/users/{id} updates name, email and role and returns MSG10.
exp: Response JSON body: code "MSG10", message "Cập nhật tài khoản thành công.".
One user.updated entry is written to the audit log.
pre: A test account "Tên Cũ" / cu@trustcabinet.local exists.

cases.d: Verify changing an account's role does not sign that account out.

req.body: { "fullName": "Lê Thành Viên", "email": "thanhvien@trustcabinet.local", "roleId": "<id of the Secretary role>" }

steps: In the browser where thanhvien@trustcabinet.local is signed in, reload the page.
exp: The member stays signed in; the session is not revoked.
pre: thanhvien@trustcabinet.local is signed in in another browser.

cases.d: Verify PUT /api/users/{id} returns 404 for an unknown account.

req.body: { "fullName": "Tên hợp lệ", "email": "hople@trustcabinet.local", "roleId": "<id of the Member role>" }

cases.d: Verify PUT /api/users/{id} cannot change the account status.

req.body: { "fullName": "Lê Thành Viên", "email": "thanhvien@trustcabinet.local", "roleId": "<id of the Member role>", "isActive": false }

steps: Send GET request to /api/users/<id of thanhvien@trustcabinet.local>.
exp: The update is accepted without the isActive field taking effect.
The account is still active (isActive true).

cases.d: Verify account writes are refused without AdminUsers.
steps: Send PUT request to /api/users/<id of thanhvien@trustcabinet.local> with header Authorization: Bearer <access token of thuky@trustcabinet.local>.
Send PUT request to /api/users/<id of thanhvien@trustcabinet.local>/status with the same header and body { "isActive": false }.
exp: Nothing is written to the audit log.

cases.d: Verify deactivating an account returns MSG11 and ends its sessions.
steps: In the browser where thanhvien@trustcabinet.local is signed in, reload the page.
exp: Response JSON body: code "MSG11", message "Đổi trạng thái tài khoản thành công.", user.isActive false.
The member's session ends and the sign-in page is shown.
One user.deactivated entry is written to the audit log.
pre: thanhvien@trustcabinet.local is active and signed in in another browser.

cases.d: Verify reactivating an account returns MSG11.
exp: Response JSON body has code "MSG11" and user.isActive true.
One user.reactivated entry is written to the audit log.

cases.d: Verify setting the status an account already has returns MSG12 with 409.
exp: Response JSON body: code "MSG12", message "Không thể đổi trạng thái tài khoản này.".
Nothing is written to the audit log.

cases.d: Verify an administrator cannot deactivate their own account.
Verify a deactivated administrator is refused even with a still valid access token.

req.as: Authorization: Bearer <access token of the administrator, issued before deactivation>

exp: Nothing is written to the audit log.
pre: A second administrator signed in and kept the access token.
That administrator was then deactivated by quantri@trustcabinet.local.

cases.d: Verify the status change refuses a body that does not state isActive.
steps: Send PUT request to /api/users/<id of thanhvien@trustcabinet.local>/status with header Authorization: Bearer <access token of quantri@trustcabinet.local> and body {}.
Repeat with body { "is_active": true }.
Repeat with body { "active": true }.
exp: Each request returns HTTP 400 Bad Request.
Nothing is written to the audit log.

cases.d: Verify the status change returns 404 for an unknown account.
Verify requesting a password reset returns MSG13 and emails the account.
steps: Open the mailbox of the account (SMTP sandbox).
exp: Response JSON body: code "MSG13", message "Đã gửi email đặt lại mật khẩu.", user.id is the account's id.
One email with a reset link arrives at the account's address.
pre: The account is active and signs in with a password.

cases.d: Verify a password reset for a deactivated account returns MSG14.
exp: Response JSON body: code "MSG14", message "Tài khoản này không dùng được chức năng đặt lại mật khẩu.".

cases.d: Verify a password reset for a Google-only account (no password) returns MSG14.
pre: The target account signs in only with Google and has no password.

cases.d: Verify a password reset returns MSG15 with 503 when the email cannot be sent.
exp: Response JSON body: code "MSG15", message "Không gửi được email đặt lại mật khẩu. Vui lòng thử lại.".
pre: The SMTP server is stopped, so mail cannot be sent.

cases.d: Verify a password reset returns 404 for an unknown account.
Verify requesting a password reset needs AdminUsers.
Verify the emailed reset link sets the new password and returns MSG92 without signing in.
steps: As quantri@trustcabinet.local, request a password reset for thanhvien@trustcabinet.local.
Copy the token from the link in the email.
Send POST request to /api/auth/password-reset with header Content-Type: application/json and no authentication.
Request JSON body: { "token": "<token from the email>", "newPassword": "MotMatKhauMoiRatDai@2026" }.
Sign in as thanhvien@trustcabinet.local with the new password.
exp: Response JSON body: code "MSG92", message "Đặt lại mật khẩu thành công. Vui lòng đăng nhập bằng mật khẩu mới.".
Sign-in with the new password succeeds.

cases.d: Verify an unknown or missing reset token returns MSG93.
steps: Send POST request to /api/auth/password-reset with body { "token": "khong-ton-tai", "newPassword": "MotMatKhauMoiRatDai@2026" }.
Repeat with body { "newPassword": "MotMatKhauMoiRatDai@2026" }.
Repeat with body {}.
Request headers for each request: Content-Type: application/json, no authentication.
exp: Each request returns HTTP 400 Bad Request.
Each response JSON body: code "MSG93", message "Liên kết đặt lại mật khẩu không hợp lệ hoặc đã hết hạn. Vui lòng liên hệ quản trị viên.".

cases.d: Verify a too short new password returns MSG94 on the newPassword field.
steps: As quantri@trustcabinet.local, request a password reset for thanhvien@trustcabinet.local and copy the token from the email.
Send POST request to /api/auth/password-reset with body { "token": "<token from the email>", "newPassword": "ngan" }.
exp: Response JSON body has code "MSG94" ("Mật khẩu mới không hợp lệ.") and an error on newPassword.
The old password still works; the link is not spent.
